title: Aloha menu rebuild pipeline (audit → gate → normalize → shadow → verify)
summary: The five-step rebuild for an Aloha venue: canonical audit first, written approval, normalization + isolation + midnight sweep, v2 shadow workbench, verification — ADM-side changes are made by the operator between gates.

steps.title: Run the full menu audit and write the client report
Client approval of audit findings + scope
steps.instructions: Present the audit report (HIGH/MEDIUM findings, 86-cascade exposure). Obtain WRITTEN approval for the scope: targeted fix vs full normalization. Never touch the live system before this gate.

steps.title: Operator applies the rebuilt structure in ADM
steps.instructions: Between gates: rebuild blocks/sections/modifiers in ADM exactly as the workbench shows; export the new build and re-import here (io.import.menu) for parity confirmation.
